product.name: Monoprice 6in RCA Female to 2x RCA Male Digital Coaxial Splitter Adapter
product.description: This Digital Coax Cable is made from premium quality RG-6/U with double copper braid shielding to prevent signal degradation caused by EMI and RFI interference. This cable is ideal for conducting S/PDIF digital audio signals and other high-bandwidth content, but it can also be used for composite video and other line level RCA signals.This splitter features a single RCA female jack on one end and a pair of RCA male plugs on the other end. The purpose of this is adapter to split a single RCA output to send to two RCA inputs.Note that this should be used only as a splitter. Combining audio signals could result in damage to your audio equipment. The proper way to combine audio signals is through an audio mixer. Features: Gold plated RCA male connectorsRubber-covered, molded connector housings97% pure oxygen-free copper conductorDouble shielded with copper braiding22 pF per foot capacitance75 ohm impedance                       Warning: This product may contain a chemical known to the State of California to cause cancer, birth defects, or other reproductive harm.
